svg.title: Contribution arcade
svg.desc: Platformer level built from my last 26 weeks of contributions: 847 contributions, a 11-day streak, 1 years on GitHub. 5 hearts mark the busiest weeks.
svg.text: Each column is one of my last 26 weeks: the taller the column, the more contributions that
week. Hearts mark my busiest weeks and the number is that week's contributions.
